verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical and both fail. Each keeps the five-line stacked headline in tiny type that nearly touches the top and bottom edges, when this banner shape calls for one line of larger text. Each also pulls the red T off to the right, losing the original's layered text-on-T effect and leaving a huge empty band in the middle. A pins the text block to the far left, so its dead gap is even bigger. B moves the text in a little, which makes the gap smaller but leaves an arbitrary empty strip on the left, and its 'AGAINST CRUELTY' line looks cramped.
